[[Jade Brotherhood Knight]]s are the [[warrior]]s of the [[Jade Brotherhood]]. They are fairly sturdy, but are not much of a threat unless their opponents bunch up and provide targets for their [[Cyclone Axe]] and [[Triple Chop]].

==Dialogue==
;During Deactivating P.O.X.:
:''"A real gang is respected by the populace. We make our presence known every day in this city, instead of sneaking though sewers like rats."''
:''"Canthan citizens speak of the Jade Brotherhood with reverence and respect. They speak of the Am Fah only with disgust."''
:''"Cowardly Am Fah, always hiding in the sewers. Feh! Some gang."''
:''"I cut my teeth killing Am Fah. Now I recruit the cream of Canthan's nobles to do the same."''
:''"The Am Fah wage a war they can never win."''
:''"The Jade Brotherhood stands at a precipice, an Asuran has delivered victory into our hands.
:''"The only good Am Fah is a rotting corpse...surrounded by flies. Oh, and the only thing better than that is two Am Fah corpses...and more flies."''
:''"The tide of about to turn in this war! The sewers will fill with Am Fah blood."''
:''"There is only room for one gang in Cantha."''
:''"This city has erupted into chaos. But out of chaos is born order...a new order led by the Jade Brotherhood."''
:''"Watch your back! we{{sic}} have battled the Am Fah all day in the bazaar. it{{sic}} is a hornet's nest down there."''
:''"Wait until the Am Fah sees our new weapon. They will never know what hit them."''
:''"When our new weapon is unleashed, the Am Fah will be no more."''
:''"When you join the Jade Brotherhood, you are Jade Brotherhood for life."''

;During Trial of Zinn, before and after the trial:
:''"It is strange being away from Cantha. Where are all the buildings? It's unnatural!"''

==Quotes==
;During the quest Deactivating P.O.X.:
:''"A clean death is too good for you!"''
:''"Am Fah scum! Cut them down!"''
:''"Die! Die! DIE!"
:''"Death by my hands is better than you deserve."''
:''"Disappointing! I hoped you Am Fah would at least put up a fight!"''
:''"My superior noble blood shall spill yours, mutt."''
:''"You live with the rats, but must you look like them?"''
:''"You picked the wrong day to fight the Brotherhood"''
